final: WITH g AS (SELECT positionText AS code, SUM(laps) AS s FROM results GROUP BY positionText), t AS (SELECT SUM(s) AS tot FROM g), d AS (SELECT g.code AS code, g.s AS s, g.s * 1.0 / t.tot AS dv FROM g JOIN t ON t.tot IS NOT NULL), a AS (SELECT AVG(dv) AS av FROM d), k AS (SELECT d.code AS code, d.s AS s, d.dv AS dv, d.dv - a.av AS diff FROM d JOIN a ON a.av IS NOT NULL WHERE d.dv > a.av) SELECT SUM(s) AS total_laps, AVG(dv) AS avg_division, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM k
